question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'engrossing'to fill in the blank.

The historical novel was quite ___________________, transporting readers to a bygone era.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Involving)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"engrossing"** means extremely interesting and captivating, capable of holding one's attention completely. (रोमांचक, ध्यान खींचने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** The engrossing story kept me awake all night, eager to know what happens next.
 
 
 
• **"Involving"** refers to something that engages or captures attention deeply, making the audience feel a part of the experience. (शामिल करने वाला, दिलचस्प)
 
 
• **Example:** The involving movie plot kept the viewers glued to their seats till the very end.
 
 
 
• Hence, "engrossing" is synonymous with "involving."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Involving)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rancid** (बासी): Refers to food or substances that have gone bad, often having an unpleasant smell or taste.

 
 
• **Example:** The butter had turned rancid after being left out in the heat.
 
 
 
• **Malodorous** (दुर्गंधयुक्त): Something that has a bad smell.
 
 
• **Example:** The malodorous garbage was unbearable in the summer heat.
 
 
 
• **Musty** (सीलनयुक्त): Refers to something stale or damp-smelling, typically associated with old places or items.
 
 
• **Example:** The musty smell in the basement made it unpleasant to stay there.
